cards.name: Andúril
cards.quote: The Sword that was Broken shall be Reforged.
cards.description: Reforged from the shards of an ancient blade, carried by the king who reclaimed the throne of Gondor.

cards.name: Sting
cards.quote: Its blade glimmers blue when danger draws near.
cards.description: A small Elvish knife, more a long dagger to a Man, found forgotten in a troll's hoard.

cards.name: Nenya
cards.quote: A single stone that glitters like frost, set in a ring of white gold.
cards.description: One of the Three Rings of the Elves, kept unsullied and hidden from the Enemy's sight.

cards.name: Vilya
cards.quote: The mightiest of the Three, set with a sapphire deep as the sky.
cards.description: Worn secretly by a great Elf-lord, its power lets its bearer see far beyond mortal sight.

cards.name: Shards of Narsil
cards.quote: Broken, but never truly lost.
cards.description: The fragments of an ancient blade that once cut a Ring from a Dark Lord's hand, kept as an heirloom of kings.

cards.name: Mithril coat
cards.quote: Light as a feather, hard as dragon scales.
cards.description: A shirt of silver mail from the deep mines of the Dwarves, worth more than the realm it was forged for.

cards.name: Lembas
cards.quote: One small bite is enough to fill the stomach of a grown man.
cards.description: Waybread of the Elves, wrapped in mallorn leaves, meant to sustain a traveler on the longest road.

cards.name: Miruvor
cards.quote: A cordial that warms the heart and quickens the step.
cards.description: A restorative drink of Rivendell, kept in a small silver flask for the direst need.

cards.name: Athelas
cards.quote: A weed, some would call it — until it is needed.
cards.description: Kingsfoil, a humble herb whose crushed leaves clear the mind and ease the deepest hurts.

cards.name: Ring of Barahir
cards.quote: Two serpents, their eyes of emerald, coiled beneath a golden crown.
cards.description: An heirloom of the Kings of Númenor, given long ago as a token of an unbreakable oath.

cards.name: Herugrim
cards.quote: A blade unsheathed at last, its edge remembering how to bite.
cards.description: The sword of a king of the Mark, long kept still in its scabbard by a whispering counselor.

cards.name: Golden Armor of Rohan
cards.quote: Gilded mail for a lord of horses.
cards.description: Ceremonial war-gear of Rohan, gleaming gold beneath a red cloak.

cards.name: Snowmane
cards.quote: Fleetest of the horses of the Mark.
cards.description: A great warhorse of Rohan, faithful even unto the last charge.

cards.name: The Arkenstone
cards.quote: The Heart of the Mountain, and it shall be called the King's Jewel.
cards.description: A gem of impossible brilliance, the heart-stone of a Dwarf kingdom beneath the mountain.

cards.name: Palantir of Annuminas
cards.quote: A dark globe that once watched over the North Kingdom.
cards.description: One of the seeing-stones of old, standing silent now among the ruins of a fallen capital.

cards.name: Palantir of Amon Sul
cards.quote: Its stone still turns atop the windswept hill.
cards.description: A seeing-stone kept once at a watchtower in the wild, guarding the roads of the North.

cards.name: Palantir of Elostirion
cards.quote: Said to look only West, across the Sundering Sea.
cards.description: A stone housed in a white tower, its gaze fixed forever on a shore beyond mortal reach.

cards.name: Palantir of Fornost
cards.quote: Buried beneath the ruin of a kingdom's last stand.
cards.description: A seeing-stone recovered from the fallen fortress of the North Kingdom.

cards.name: Palantir of Minas Tirith
cards.quote: Kept in the highest chamber of the White Tower.
cards.description: A seeing-stone of the Stewards, its true use nearly forgotten by their heirs.

cards.name: Palantir of Osgiliath
cards.quote: Lost beneath the waters when the city fell.
cards.description: A stone that sank with the ruin of the river-city, its fate unknown for long years.

cards.name: TheMirrorOfGaladriel
cards.quote: It shows things that were, things that are, and some things that have not yet come to pass.
cards.description: A silver basin filled with water from a woodland stream, revealing visions to those it permits.

cards.name: Iron Crown
cards.quote: A crown fit for a lord who fears no blade.
cards.description: A heavy circlet of black iron, worn by one who commands rather than pleads for loyalty.

cards.name: Ring of Orthanc
cards.quote: A small thing, for one who once thought himself great.
cards.description: Forged in vain imitation of a far greater power, worn by a wizard who fell from wisdom into ambition.

cards.name: Palantir of Orthanc
cards.quote: The stone in the black tower answers to a will stronger than its keeper's.
cards.description: A seeing-stone of Isengard, dangerous to any who gaze into it unprepared.

cards.name: Palantir of Ithil
cards.quote: It fell into shadow long before the tower did.
cards.description: The seeing-stone of the Moon-tower, now turned to purposes its makers never intended.

cards.name: Long Bow
cards.quote: Drawn full, it sings before it looses.
cards.description: A tall bow favored by rangers of the wild, its reach far greater than its plain wood suggests.

cards.name: War Axe
cards.quote: Forged for splitting shields, not kindling.
cards.description: A heavy battle-axe of Dwarvish make, balanced for a single, decisive stroke.

cards.name: Black Arrow
cards.quote: Save the last arrow for the worm's own heart.
cards.description: A grim, black-feathered shaft, passed down for the day a dragon must finally be answered.

cards.name: Blue Bow
cards.quote: Its string hums a note no other bow can match.
cards.description: An Elvish bow inlaid with pale silver, its draw stronger than its slender frame suggests.

cards.name: Orcrist
cards.quote: Biter, the Goblins of the mountains once called it, and feared it.
cards.description: An Elvish blade that glows in the presence of Orcs, forged in a war long passed from memory.

cards.name: Phial of Galadriel
cards.quote: May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out.
cards.description: A crystal vial holding the captured light of a star, a gift for the darkest of roads.

cards.name: Glamdring
cards.quote: Foe-hammer, the Goblins named it, and none wished to hear its ring again.
cards.description: An ancient Elvish blade carried by a wandering wizard, unforgiving to servants of the Enemy.

cards.name: Guthwinë
cards.quote: A blade that rides beside its master into every charge.
cards.description: The sword of a marshal of the Riddermark, well-worn by long years in the saddle.

cards.name: Horn of Gondor
cards.quote: Blow it in extremity, and aid will come, provided a foot still stands to answer.
cards.description: A great war-horn of the House of the Stewards, banded in ancient silver.

cards.name: Elessar
cards.quote: A green stone with the shape of an eagle wrought upon it.
cards.description: A healing jewel set into a brooch, said to ease sickness and pain in the hand of the one who bears it rightly.

cards.name: Narya
cards.quote: The Ring of Fire, hidden in a plain iron setting.
cards.description: One of the Three, its quiet power kindles courage and resistance to despair in those nearby.

cards.name: Murazor's Ring
cards.quote: The first to fall, and the deepest bound to the shadow.
cards.description: The ring of the foremost of the Nine, its wearer long since more shadow than man.

cards.name: Khamul's Ring
cards.quote: Its wearer no longer casts a shadow of his own — only his master's.
cards.description: A ring of the Nine, sustaining a servant who was a Man once, in a distant age.

cards.name: Akhorahil's Ring
cards.quote: Cold to the touch, colder in its purpose.
cards.description: One of the Nine Rings, its serpentine band a mark of an ancient, broken oath.

cards.name: Indur's Ring
cards.quote: Its bearer remembers a throne he no longer sits upon.
cards.description: A ring of the Nine, once belonging to one who was a lord in his own right before he was a servant.

cards.name: Ovatha's Ring
cards.quote: Worn by one whose name is spoken less than feared.
cards.description: A dark ring of the Nazgûl, its history recorded more in absence than in deed.

cards.name: Adunaphel's Ring
cards.quote: The only one among the Nine to remember what it was to choose.
cards.description: A cruelly elegant ring, worn by the sole woman among the Nazgûl.

cards.name: Ren's Ring
cards.quote: The Unclean, some called its bearer, before the name itself was forgotten.
cards.description: A heavy iron ring of the Nine, its wearer's name all but erased by centuries of shadow.

cards.name: Hoarmurath's Ring
cards.quote: Frost follows wherever this ring's bearer rides.
cards.description: A ring of the Nazgûl touched with an unnatural cold, said to herald harsh winters.

cards.name: Dwar's Ring
cards.quote: Once a king of Men, now only a shadow that hastens.
cards.description: A ring of the Nine that grants its wearer unnatural speed, a small mercy for eternal servitude.

cards.name: First Age Banner
cards.quote: Its colors have not been seen in an age of the world.
cards.description: A tattered war-banner, its heraldry worn nearly to nothing by the endless turning of years.

cards.name: Second Age Banner
cards.quote: Carried into battles that history barely remembers.
cards.description: A faded standard from a fallen alliance, its cloth heavier with dust than with glory.

cards.name: Horse-tamer
cards.quote: In the right hands, even the wildest colt will kneel.
cards.description: A simple herding rod of the Rohirrim, worn smooth by generations of horse-lords.

cards.name: Easterling Helmet
cards.quote: Taken from a foe who no longer needed it.
cards.description: An ornate war-helm of the Easterlings, its crest still bearing the horns of its distant homeland.

cards.name: Westernesse Blade
cards.quote: Cold iron, and colder still to the things that do not belong in the living world.
cards.description: A barrow-blade of Númenórean make, its runes etched to bite deep against ancient evils.

cards.name: Elfbane
cards.quote: Forged in a hatred as old as its edge is sharp.
cards.description: A curved blade of the South, made expressly to answer the Elves' ancient enmity.
